files.job-api.json: Raw Kubernetes Job object, including immutable spec and terminal conditions.
files.pod-api.json: Raw Pod list query after Job TTL cleanup; empty when the Pod object is no longer retained.
files.events-api.json: Raw Events list query filtered to the retained Pod UID.
files.status-tool.json: Isolab status API response, including Job identity and retained Pod list.
files.results-listing.json: Isolab results API response with each S3 key, byte count, timestamp and checksum metadata.
files.container.log: Exact bounded logs API text; empty string means no retained container logs.
files.terminal-receipt.json: Normalized terminal state and explicit producer-start evidence boundary.
files.observed-at.txt: UTC time when terminal evidence collection ran.
files.DATA_INDEX.json: Map of every evidence payload by path, byte length, SHA-256 and role.
files.manifest.sha256: SHA-256 for all preceding files except this manifest.

interpretation.deadline_failure: Infrastructure timeout, not a mathematical or enumerator failure.
interpretation.source_objects: Source bundle custody only; it is not factor-base output.
interpretation.missing_pod: Kubernetes retention/TTL visibility limit; prior pending receipts remain preserved.
